name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Wrath of the Druids
summary: Eivor’s latest journey takes them to shores of Ireland, where the newly-appointed High-King Flann Sinna seeks to unite four disparate regions under a single Irish banner. Along the way, Eivor will discover the secrets of an ancient druidic cult, encounter fearsome mythological creatures, and explore Ireland’s many mysteries.

name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: The Siege of Paris
summary: Sail to the kingdom of Francia and engage the forces of Charles the Fat as you participate in the Vikings' most daring conquest. Infiltrate the city of Paris, forge new alliances within its walls, and strike a blow that will shatter an empire.

name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: The Way of the Berserker
summary: The Way of the Berserker is a single-player downloadable content addition for Assassin's Creed: Valhalla and was released on 10 November 2020 as a pre-order bonus. The content consists of three missions in which Eivor joins a legendary Norse Berserker on his quest for revenge.

name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Dawn of Ragnarök
summary: In the most ambitious expansion in franchise history, Eivor must embrace their destiny as Odin, the Norse god of Battle and Wisdom. Unleash new divine powers as you embark on a desperate quest through a breathtaking world. Complete a legendary Viking saga and save your son in the face of the gods’ doom.

name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Forgotten Saga
summary: This free game mode is inspired by the rogue-lite genre and presents players with a new challenge as enemies are relentless and every choice counts.

name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: The Legend of Beowulf
summary:
The Legend of Beowulf is a single-player downloadable content addition for Assassin's Creed: Valhalla that was released on 10 November 2020 for Season Pass holders. The content consists of three missions in which Eivor discovers the secrets behind the legendary hero Beowulf.

The Legend of Beowulf memories can be accessed after founding Ravensthorpe, but a Power Level of 20 is recommended.
